STATEMENT OF WORK #67
This Statement of Work together with any attachments (the “Statement of Work”) is dated as of the date
of the last signature below (the “Effective Date”) and is by and between Metsera, Inc., having its principal
place of business 1200 Morris Turnpike, Suite 3005, Short Hills, NJ 07078, USA (“Metsera”), and
Altasciences Preclinical Columbia, LLC with a principal place of business at 562 State Road DD,
Auxvasse, MO 65231 (“Service Provider”), and, upon execution, will be incorporated into, subject to
and governed by the Master Services Agreement between Metsera and Service Provider dated October
17, 2023 (the “Agreement”). Capitalized terms not otherwise defined in this Statement of Work shall
have the same meaning as set forth in the Agreement. Metsera hereby engages Service Provider to
provide Services, as follows:
Services. Attached hereto and incorporated herein as a part of this Statement of Work is a detailed
description of the Services (including any specifications, Materials (provided by Metsera) and
Deliverables) to be provided by Service Provider under this Statement of Work in connection with the
Study entitled "A 28-Day Toxicity Study in Göttingen Minipigs of MET097 with a 14-Day Recovery
Period (GLP)" (the "Study") in compliance with the requirements set out in the attached quote #24-
9008 (“Attachment 1”). Service Provider will perform the Services in accordance with the terms of this
Statement of Work and the Agreement. All Records will be provided to Metsera in a mutually agreed to
format.
1. Estimated Timeline/Statement of Work Term. The Services will commence upon full execution of
this Statement of Work and all Services and Deliverables due hereunder are anticipated to be completed
by December 31, 2025. This Statement of Work will terminate when the Services are completed and
Deliverables are accepted by Metsera. The timeline may be extended by mutual written agreement by
the Parties. Any agreed upon intermediate timelines shall be set forth in the description of Services in
the applicable Protocol.
2. Project Leader. Service Provider shall appoint a “Project Leader” after the Statement of Work is
executed.
3. Budget and Payment. Metsera will compensate Service Provider for the Services performed
hereunder in accordance with the Budget and Payment Schedule set forth below. In any event, total
payments under this Statement of Work, shall not exceed Four Hundred Eighty-One Thousand Six
Hundred Sixty Dollars ($481,660.00 USD)
Service Fee

5. STORAGE
5.1 DELIVERABLES, TEST ARTICLE, & SAMPLES
The Deliverables, Test Articles, and Samples will be stored for one (1) year following shipment of the final
report or final deliverable. Following this period, all Deliverables, Test Articles, and Samples will be
returned to the Sponsor, destroyed, or stored at Sponsor’s expense based on current rates as reflected in
an Archive Price Summary executed by both Parties.
5.2 DOCUMENTS
Service Provider will maintain documentation for the Services and Deliverables in accordance with
all Applicable Laws and all applicable authorities' regulations. Service Provider will archive, at its own
cost, all records for one (1) year following shipment of the final report and related Deliverables, as
outlined in the estimate or the final deliverable, if no report, as reflected in an Archive Price Summary
executed by both Parties.
6. TERMINATION/DELAY - ANIMAL STUDIES
For animal studies, delay and termination charges will be assessed as outlined in Section 3 of the
Agreement and detailed in a fully executed Change Order.
7. All terms and conditions of the Agreement apply to this Statement of Work.
8. This Statement of Work may be executed electronically by pdf or facsimile and in any number of
counterparts, each of which when so executed and delivered shall be an original, but all of which shall
constitute one and the same instrument.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have caused this Statement of Work to be executed by their
duly authorized representatives as of the date of the last signature below.
